rule.uses: dates and input presence only; no scores or outcomes
rule.R1: first date on or before 2017-01-03 and last date on or after 2025-12-31
rule.R2: at most 5 XNYS sessions missing of 2,262, counting alarmed files
rule.R3: complete stock bars on every session in the pinned stock-daily-bars or stock-daily-bars-300
rule.R4: complete volume22 and volume66 liquidity keys on every session
rule.R5: before 2024 only: the converter does not refuse the name or a material share of its days for a bar-versus-vendor mismatch
rule.R6: at least 40 market-eligible rows (rn_proxy_eligible, the recipe's min_fit) in 2017-2019; agent judgement reading 'every required input' to include the market inputs; dropping it gives 212 names

known_limits: Survival bias remains: all 166 come from lists built after the fact and must exist through 2025; size unmeasured.
R6 conditions on early chain liquidity: names such as F, DHR, DUK, NEE and TJX lack two-sided strikes in 2017-2019.
9 names are kept with a crossed-quote batch flag (MELI MRVL MS MSFT MSTR MU NFLX NKE NVDA); the stricter list is 157.
GOOG and GOOGL are one issuer.
2024-2025 identity changes are untested under the seal.
